title: Cross-Test Profile Engine V1
notes: Cross-Test Profile is a downstream synthesis layer, not a universal score.
No raw-score averaging is performed across instruments.
RIASEC is the first registered adapter and contributes interest evidence only.
Unsupported test types produce no synthetic evidence.
Profile completeness reflects actual available evidence domains.
Study Direction, Major Fit, and Career Exploration remain downstream of Phase 3.6.
